problems.title: Uniform sub-Gaussian parameter dependence in Corollary 3.13(26)

source_claim.locator: PDF pp.5,15,19; notation c, Definition 3.6/footnote9, Eq.(26)
source_claim.text: An absolute c and row count c alpha^2 epsilon^-2[n log(ndN')+log(1/delta)] suffice for every permitted sub-Gaussian ensemble.

assumptions: Independent mean-zero unit-variance entries; Luxemburg psi2 norm <=alpha
For any proposed c>0, C=28c log2, q=exp(-8C-8), m=ceil(C alpha^2)

steps: Z=+/-q^-1/2 with probability q/2 each, and0 otherwise; EZ=0,EZ^2=1.
alpha^2=1/[q log(1+1/q)] gives E exp(Z^2/alpha^2)=2 exactly.
Stated bound becomes m>=C alpha^2 and is satisfied.
If column1 vanishes then S e1=0 although ||e1||=1.
Success probability <=mq<=C/log(1+1/q)+q<1/8+e^-8<1/2.
check.result: Finite counterexample for every candidate absolute constant; stated success probability >=1/2 is impossible.

counterevidence: Main deterministic covering theorem contains no alpha and is not refuted.
Fixed Gaussian or uniformly bounded-alpha scope is not refuted.
SORS branch not addressed; Theorem3.12(18) retains log alpha and is not refuted by this witness.

impact.dependency: Core application passes from covering/Gaussian width to a false uniform ensemble guarantee.
impact.scope: Major concerns advertised polynomial-sketching distributional scope; no whole-paper failure inferred.

correction.statement: Restrict ensemble or establish sufficient correct dependence on its parameter.
correction.verification: Avoiding an empty column requires order1/q rows at fixed confidence, corresponding asymptotically to alpha^2 log alpha.
correction.limits: Necessary obstruction only; complete replacement theorem not proved.

problems.title: Squared normalized-slice equations lose signs

source_claim.text: The displayed polynomial system equals the intended normalized affine-slice preimage.

steps: Squared constraint admits t=+1 and-1 with w=1/2.
pi(p(-1))=(-1/sqrt2,1/sqrt2) is not in L.
On each path component, each normalized coordinate is continuous with values in a two-point set, hence its sign is constant.
check.result: Set equality is false, but the desired preimage is a union of whole components of the larger algebraic set.

counterevidence: POMT count survives; no counterexample to stated regularity bound.

impact.dependency: Auxiliary regularity input for normalized polynomial images.

correction.statement: Replace equality by larger algebraic set plus componentwise sign selection.
correction.verification: Continuous discrete-valued normalized coordinates prove no increase in component count.
correction.limits: No rederivation of external POMT theorem.
